variant_description: Austria, Empire. , Breast Star. Embroidered with sequins and silver bullion, with a central red and silver medallion, surrounded by a silver circle inscribed: FORTITUDINI in golden bullion embroidery. The revers with a paper backer. Probably by Alckens in Vienna. Original example from the 1st half of the 19th century. The austrian Military M.Theresia Order is one of the most prestigious military order in the world and was awarded in all classes very rarely for extraordinary personal bravery, valour and outstanding merits in troop leadership. The Grand Cross was awarded only 61 times during the entire award period from 1757 to 1918. Of greatest rarity, a fantastic piece in perfect condition! 7,5 x 7,5 cm.. Barac 458 I
